finding: Sampled process-tree CPU sum is based on cumulative lifetime CPU and PID/parent matching, without creation-time validation or first-sample subtraction. It is not a reliable interval CPU measure.
effect: Do not use process-tree CPU field in any causal conclusion. Historical logs remain unchanged. Host GetSystemTimes busy percentage, GlobalMemoryStatusEx available RAM and wall/test durations are separate measurements. Sampled process-tree memory is approximate and may suffer ancestry ambiguity.
rootCauseBoundary: Cumulative accounting flaw is directly visible in helper source; PID reuse or stale parent identifiers could add unrelated processes, but that mechanism was not separately proved in the completed build.
action: Preserve original logs, disclose limitation, rely on host-level resource counters and repeated unchanged-test outcomes. No application/test/guard changes made for this limitation.
